preconditions.description: The number of rows and columns n must be between 1 and 100.
The number of ones k must be between 0 and 1,000,000.
The number of ones k must not exceed the total number of cells in the matrix.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if k > n * n else True
postconditions.description: If k exceeds the total number of cells, output -1.

postconditions.expression: all(row == row[::-1] for row in matrix) and sum(sum(row) for row in matrix) == k
postconditions.description: The resulting matrix must be symmetrical and contain exactly k ones.

postconditions.expression: any(matrix[i][j] == 1 for i in range(n) for j in range(n)) if k > 0 else True
postconditions.description: If k is greater than 0, the matrix must contain at least one 1.
